text:
maria: Quick thread to nail down the acceptance checklist for the long-term routing commitments (multi-region + tenant isolation + fallback economics). I want concrete gates we can use in PRDs and contracts. Short replies.
kevin: Proposal: three numeric gates per lane: perf (p99), cost-multiplier, ops-blast-radius. Example: fast p99<=120ms | cost x1.35 | blast-radius <= 1 region.
sanjay: For isolation modes define: shared, logical-slice (namespaces + token quotas), dedicated-slice. I'll add infra multipliers per model class. Estimate logical-slice +15%, dedicated +35% median.
lisa: Sales note: enterprise customers insist on country-level residency, VPC peering SLA, and a clause for dedicated-hosting. Need customer-facing checklist for contract review.
noah: Runtime items: policy DSL must express region-priority, fallback chains, and a migrate_grace value for warmup. Tiny example: ```policy { id: "fast-eu" select: "region=eu" slo: "p99<=120ms" fallback: ["fast-rr","balanced-eu"] migrate_grace: "12h" }```
emma: Telemetry idea: compute a single "isolation_index" (0-100) composed of tail-variance, kv-warmup-size, and error-spike frequency. Use index to auto-recommend slice and to warn about eviction cost. Thresholds: <30 shared, 30-70 logical-slice, >70 dedicated.
carmen: Ops asks: define an "eviction grace" billing treatment and a default 12h erosion window. Also require a migration runbook that includes prefill, shadowing, and a kill-switch.
maria: Draft launch gates I propose: 1) SLA matrix + perf harness validated on staging; 2) policy DSL v0 + examples; 3) isolation_index computed for 3 pilot tenants; 4) migration runbook + billing annex for grace window; 5) customer one-pager mapping asks to acceptance language. Anything missing?
kevin: Add: e2e chaos test that simulates region failover and model fallback; acceptance: SLOs hold within lane limits. I'll own the test.
sanjay: Add ops-cost appendix (FTE uplift) for logical vs dedicated. I'll model small/med/large cases by Thu.
lisa: I'll produce the customer checklist and coordinate with legal on residency language.
noah: I'll publish a short RFC for DSL semantics (failover, versioned fallbacks, budget caps) by Tue.
emma: I'll prototype the isolation_index dashboard tile and run it against two pilots next week.
carmen: Ops will draft migration runbook and simulate a warmup in staging overnight Wed.
calendarbot: meeting created: "Routing commitments & acceptance sync" Thu 09:30 Zoom link posted.
maria: OK, I'll assemble a PRD stub with these gates and owners and share before the sync. Please add blockers here.
